noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

expr.description:
This attribute defines an expression that identifies a valid set of options
that applies to the annotated field. The expression will be evaluated against
the object holding the annotated field and expected result is an array of
objects with type being the type of the annotated field

filter.description:
This attribute can be used instead of the restrictionExpr attribute. It
restricts choice of the field value to a subset of the value type of the
annotated field. The filter used to create this subset if specified in this
attribute.

callback.description:
This attribute names the function defined in the annotated field’s type that
provides the restriction set for the annotated field. This function can use the
object holding the annotated field and it can return either an array of objects
of the value type of the annotated field, or a fetch filter on that type, or a
single value that is calculated to be the choice. This
attribute can only be used when multiple steps are required for performing the
restriction and these involve separate db calls.
function(T affectedObj): Obj anyOf ([U], string)

order.description: ordering of values fetched when the filter is applied
